lineage.description: Population data from Niue national census was spatially aggregated to village administrative boundaries and analyzed for coastal proximity as part of a multi-country Pacific study on population distribution relative to coastal hazard zones. The dataset provides census-derived demographic counts (total population, sex disaggregation, occupied households) linked to village-level geographic units.
